Class MyLibraryController

java.lang.Object
com.sebastiandorata.musicdashboard.controller.MyLibraryController
@Controller public class MyLibraryController extends Object
Serves the My Library page (GET /library) and its JSON endpoints under /api/library/.

The desktop controller was a singleton that held a LibraryState and rebuilt JavaFX nodes on every click. On the web the state is the URL query string (see LibraryState); every request builds a fresh state, loads the data for exactly one pane (Songs, Albums, Artists, Favourites, album detail or artist detail), converts it to small immutable view records and hands those to Thymeleaf. Nothing per-user or per-page is kept in a field.

JSON endpoints: favourite toggle, song read / edit / delete and album edit / delete. Every endpoint that changes library data invalidates the LibraryService cache, both immediately and again after the surrounding transaction commits so a concurrent reader cannot re-cache stale rows.

Detached-entity safety: the cached lists of LibraryService are rendered only through associations their repository queries fetch-join (song artists and genres, album artists, songs, song artists and genres, artist songs and albums); the song's album is an eager ManyToOne. Everything else (album detail, favourites, artist albums, edit endpoints) is loaded fresh during the current request.

SRP: translates HTTP requests into library service calls and view models.

Time Complexity: O(n log n) per page render for n items (sorting and grouping).

Space Complexity: O(n) for the view records of the rendered pane.

  • Method Details

    • library

      @GetMapping("/library") public String library(@RequestParam(required=false) String view, @RequestParam(required=false) String mode, @RequestParam(required=false) String sort, @RequestParam(required=false) Long genre, @RequestParam(required=false) Long album, @RequestParam(required=false) Long artist, org.springframework.ui.Model model)
      Renders the My Library page for the view state encoded in the query string.

      Model attributes: state (LibraryState), pane (songs|albums|artists|favourites|albumDetail|artistDetail), genres (all genres), sorts (all sort strategies), header (the view header text), plus pane-specific data: groups and activeLetters (alphabetical lists), albums (album cards), songs (favourites grid), total, albumDetail, artistName, artistAlbums and queueIds (the sorted song ids a double-click queues, comma-separated).

      Parameters:
      view - tab key
      mode - display mode
      sort - sort strategy name
      genre - genre id filter
      album - album id to drill into
      artist - artist id to drill into
      model - the MVC model
      Returns:
      the library template, or a redirect to the default view for an unknown id

    • editSong

      @PutMapping("/api/library/songs/{songId}") @ResponseBody @Transactional public MyLibraryController.SongDetails editSong(@PathVariable Long songId, @RequestBody MyLibraryController.SongEditRequest request)
      Applies a song edit with the SongEditDialog save logic.

      Only non-blank fields are applied. The album is looked up by title or created, artists and genres are comma-separated names looked up or created by name, and the track number is parsed leniently (an unparsable value is ignored).

      Parameters:
      songId - the song id
      request - the edited fields
      Returns:
      the song details after saving
      Throws:
      org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException - 404 when the song does not exist
